format: html

## インデックス時系列

<div id="chart" style="width:100%;height:500px;"></div>

<!-- Plotly.js の読み込み -->
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>

<script>
const symbols = ["^GSPC","^DJI","^IXIC"];
const apiKey  = "YOUR_API_KEY";  // Alpha Vantage APIキーを設定

async function fetchTimeSeries(symbol){
  const url =
    `https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY_ADJUSTED`
    + `&symbol=${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}`
    + `&apikey=${apiKey}`;
  const res  = await fetch(url);
  const json = await res.json();
  return json["Time Series (Daily)"];
}

async function drawChart(){
  const allData = await Promise.all(symbols.map(s => fetchTimeSeries(s)));
  const traces = allData.map((ts, i) => {
    const dates = Object.keys(ts).reverse();
    const prices = dates.map(d => +ts[d]["5. adjusted close"]);
    return {
      x: dates,
      y: prices,
      name: symbols[i],
      mode: "lines"
    };
  });
  Plotly.newPlot("chart", traces, {
    title: "主要市場インデックスの推移",
    xaxis: { title: "日付" },
    yaxis: { title: "株価（調整済終値）" }
  });
}

drawChart();
</script>
